title: ellipanthus peltatus
intro: Ellipanthus peltatus, commonly known as the Velvet Leaf, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The health benefits of Ellipanthus peltatus include its antioxidant and antibacterial properties, which can help to protect against infections and promote overall well-being.
